goal:
Execution statistics in POST /v1/gates/evaluate must be validated at the request boundary (CR-62, D-054).
1. services/api/main.py EvaluateRequest: vis_pass, vis_n, held_pass, held_n are integers >= 0 with vis_pass <= vis_n and
   held_pass <= held_n. Violations -> HTTP 422 (pydantic Field(ge=0) plus a model_validator). Defaults become 0 (no runs).
   Booleans, floats and numeric strings must be rejected (use StrictInt).
2. services/api/evoforge/gates.py evaluate_full: default vis_*/held_* to 0. Never coerce 0 runs into 1 run (remove max(n,1)).
   If vis_n == 0 or held_n == 0 there is no execution evidence: GH_INTEGRITY must not be PASS. If the reward-hack detectors flag
   the diff it is FAIL as today; otherwise it is INCONCLUSIVE with a reason containing "no execution evidence".
   Only call reward_hack.gap when both n > 0. Keep every other decision identical (existing tests must still pass).
3. Malformed counts passed directly to evaluate_full (negative, pass > n) raise ValueError.
